_comment: The contract(s) that really are each token on each chain. A transfer is
priced from its tokenSymbol, which the SENDER chooses, so anyone can
deploy a token called USDC for a few cents. Entries here are what makes a
counterfeit detectable.
ONLY add a contract confirmed against a block explorer or read on-chain.
A wrong entry quarantines real money, which is worse than the bug this
fixes. Anything not listed is still priced by symbol and still vulnerable.
A symbol may have SEVERAL legitimate contracts - use "contracts". On
Optimism both native USDC and bridged USDC.e report symbol "USDC"
on-chain (the bridged one was never renamed), so naming either as the only
real one would quarantine the other's genuine transfers.
Deliberately ABSENT, and why:
bsc USDC - could not be verified. Every public BSC RPC tried refused the
call, and the explorers 403. Unverified is left unmapped.
polygon USDT - no canonical contract could be established. The only one
in the substrate (0x26c68e12..., 6 records) reads name 'Tether USD'
symbol 'USDT' but declares a supply of 1,000,000,000,000 - the
counterfeit signature. The commonly cited 0xc2132D05... is NOT polygon
USDT: on-chain it is name 'USDT0' symbol 'USDT0', a different token.
base, bsc and optimism carry NO records: the free Etherscan tier does not
serve account endpoints for them. These entries are protective, correct
from the moment those chains become readable.

tokens.verified: etherscan.io — label "Circle", source code verified, exact match
polygonscan.com / blockscan.com — label "Circle: USDC Token", native USDC issued by Circle
tokens.substrate_support: 20434 records across 644 distinct addresses; no other polygon USDC contract appears at all

tokens.verified: etherscan.io - label "Tether", name "Tether USD", source verified exact match, 15,932,070 holders
tokens.substrate_support: 485 records across 122 distinct addresses; next contract has 8

tokens.verified: read on-chain via polygon.drpc.org - name() 'USDT0', symbol() 'USDT0', supply 771,730,187.78
tokens.substrate_support: none yet - protective entry, so a counterfeit USDT0 cannot be priced at par

tokens.verified: read on-chain via base.drpc.org - name() 'USD Coin', symbol() 'USDC', decimals 6, supply 4,289,141,235.59
tokens.substrate_support: none - chain unreadable on the free tier; protective entry

tokens.verified: read on-chain via base.drpc.org - name() 'USD Base Coin', symbol() 'USDbC', decimals 6, supply 5,906,879.84
tokens.substrate_support: none - protective entry; distinct symbol so it cannot collide with base USDC

tokens.verified: both read on-chain via optimism.drpc.org and BOTH report symbol 'USDC': native (supply 174,407,187.25) and bridged USDC.e (supply 19,988,193.42). Both are legitimate, hence two contracts.
tokens.substrate_support: none - chain unreadable on the free tier; protective entry
